death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Domnul a chemat-o la Sine în ziua de 13 iunie 1789.» The same page dates her birth only as «începutul secolului al XVIII-lea», which is not a year, so no birth interval is recorded.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 iunie — «Sfânta Alexandra Schimonahia, Stareța și Întemeietoarea Mănăstirii Diveevo»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Ιουνίου — «Οσία Αλεξάνδρα Ηγουμένη και θεμελιώτρια της Μονής Ντιβέεβο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and dates her «(; - 1789)». It is plainly the same woman: Agatha Semyonovna Melgunova, widowed young, tonsured in 1760 at the Florovsky monastery of Kiev with the name Alexandra, sent by a vision of the Mother of God to found a new house, who settled at Diveevo near Sarov and died there on 13 June 1789. The page records her relics at the monastery of Diveevo. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
